[[High Seneschal]] '''Peteen''' was a [[Bardottan]] [[Politics|politician]] and member of the [[Bardotta]] [[Bahk-tov Council]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars]], Peteen was the [[Frangawl cult leader|secret leader]] of a resurgent [[Frangawl Cult]]. In league with the [[Dathomirian]] [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Talzin|Mother Talzin]],<ref name="TDII" /> Peteen's cult kidnapped other Dagoyan Masters in order to suck out their [[The Force|living Force]]. Among his captives was the Dagoyan Master [[Joseph]]. However, his ultimate target was the Bardottan [[queen]], [[Julia]]. However, due to the cult's activities, Julia contacted the [[Galactic Republic]] for assistance, personally requesting the aide of her lover, [[Jar Jar Binks]]. Binks arrived, accompanied by the [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]], and they were received by Peteen's welcoming committee. Shortly after the pair's arrival, Julia was captured by the cult. Holding up his guise as a helpful bureaucrat, Peteen handed over the task of finding Julia to Binks, Windu, and the Bardottan guard [[Savatte]].<ref name="The Disappeared, Part I" />

Binks was later captured, but rescued by Windu. In addition, they discovered the cult's secret chambers underneath the Bardotta surface. Windu fought Peteen's soldiers, while the traitorous Bardottan made off with Julia,<ref name="The Disappeared, Part I" /> and took her to the [[planet]] [[Zardossa Stix]]. Windu and Binks tailed him, and eventually confronted Peteen and the remaining cult members at a Zardossa Stix pyramid, where the cultists prepared to suck the living Force out of Julia. Binks and Windu battled the guards, and eventually came face to face with Talzin, who was overseeing the operation. Windu fought Talzin, while Binks rescued Julia. Peteen, however, stumbled into the path of the Force sucking beam, and was promptly [[Death|disintegrated]].<ref name="TDII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Peteen appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' episodes "[[The Disappeared, Part I]]" and "[[The Disappeared, Part II]]." He was voiced by [[Cas Anvar]].<ref name="CA as OD">{{Topps|set=Topps On Demand|cardname=Cas Anvar as Peteen|link=https://www.beckett.com/non-sports/2018/star-wars-clone-wars-10th-anniversary-autographs/23a-cas-anvar-as-peteen-16052725}}</ref> Although not explicitly stated in the episodes, the guides revealed that Peteen was also the Frangawl Cult leader, in a role that mimicked the character of [[W:c:indianajones:Chattar Lal|Chattar Lal]] from the film [[W:c:indianajones:Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom|''Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom'']], from which the two episodes draw heavy inspiration.<ref name="TD I EG">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-disappeared-part-i-episode-guide|text="The Disappeared, Part I" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref>
